title: Associations of inflammation with neuropsychological symptom cluster in patients with Head and neck cancer: A longitudinal study
notes: NPS cluster composite outcome (fatigue+depression+pain+sleep+cognitive_impairment); NOT individual cognitive domains. Linear mixed-effects + GEE models. 4 timepoints: pre-treatment, end-RT, 3mo post, 1yr post. 56% received chemoradiotherapy. Biomarkers: CRP, TNF-alpha, sTNFR2, IL-1beta, IL-6, IL-10, MCP-1, IL-1RA. Covariates: age, sex, race, BMI, marital status, alcohol, smoking, antidepressants, anti-inflammation use, cancer stage, HPV, treatment, feeding. CRP (est=3.189, p<0.001), sTNFR2 (est=7.203, p=0.003), IL-6 (est=4.289, p<0.001), IL-1RA (est=7.115, p<0.001) all associated with higher NPS cluster. Individual symptom-level coefficients in supplementary tables (not in PDF).
extraction_status: NO_EDGE_EVIDENCE — composite NPS cluster outcome cannot be decomposed into individual cognitive domains without supplementary tables

qualitative_findings.CRP_NPS_cluster: estimate=3.189 p<0.001 (mixed-effect model, continuous NPS cluster)
qualitative_findings.one_year_persistence: CRP p=0.001, sTNFR2 p=0.006, IL-1RA p=0.043 at 1yr post-treatment
qualitative_findings.cognitive_component: PRO-CTCAE 2 items measured cognitive impairment (self-report), included in NPS cluster but not analyzed individually in main paper
